changes: Pin SDK 2026.10.12 for Python 3.8 and Ubuntu 20.04
Add default-disabled output, enable service, source timestamp validation and feedback/command watchdogs
Keep Hand 2 beta models and both MANUS configurations
Pinocchio 2.7 compatibility: Frame.parent rather than Frame.parentJoint
Named conversion to firmware finger-major order
Bound float32 roundoff within 1e-6 to declared joint limits
Extract ctypes frame reader and canonical_landmarks only
Do not copy original operator calibration files

control.behavior: Forward the selected valid target unchanged; no command slew-rate limit. Program interpolation remains in WujiClient.move_to; teleop low-pass filtering remains in retarget. Enable waits for fresh selected input before hardware enable; generation changes fence late results, and service timeouts complete on both Foxy and Jazzy.

teleop_switch.behavior: Terminal s/x/q switch and one-shot on/off commands reuse existing control and hardware services; no SDK access or motion algorithm is added.

wuji_sdk.distribution_in_tree: No; downloaded and hash-locked by Pixi

ros_environments.source: Standalone environment and build configuration in this project
ros_environments.behavior: Default Foxy/Python 3.8 and Jazzy/Python 3.12 share source and SDK/retarget versions; ROS distribution/interpreter checks and separate Jazzy build/install/log outputs prevent ABI mixing.
